response.sql: WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_name_totals) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS combined_total_points, AVG(t.avg_laps) AS average_laps_completed, AVG(t.total_points - o.avg_total) AS average_excess_points FROM race_name_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.total_points > o.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: Average laps gives each qualifying race name equal weight, using its average across result rows.

alternatives.interpretation: Average laps across all result rows for qualifying race names, so names with more results carry more weight.
